text: 15 April – The UPND General Assembly re-elects Hichilema as party president and confirms him as the party 's presidential candidate for the August general election .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 15 April – Hichilema delivers the keynote address at the 69th Annual General Meeting and Symposium of the Engineering Institution of Zambia in Livingstone .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 20 April – Hichilema announces an agreement with Zimbabwe to restrict heavy trucks and freight trains from using the Victoria Falls Bridge , with plans for a new road and rail crossing downstream on the Zambezi .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 25 April – Hichilema visits Kasama , where he pays a courtesy call on Chitimukulu , opens the Kasama Mall and Urban Hotel , and holds a community meeting .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 30 April – Hichilema officiates at the groundbreaking ceremony for shaft construction at the Mingomba copper mine in Chililabombwe .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: May 1 May – Hichilema officiates at the National Labour Day celebrations in Chinsali .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 11 – 12 May – Hichilema attends the Africa Forward Summit in Nairobi , Kenya , where he participates in discussions on development finance , peace and security , and artificial intelligence .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 22 May – Hichilema files his presidential nomination papers with the Electoral Commission of Zambia for the 2026 general election and unveils Vice - President Mutale Nalumango as his running mate .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 23 May – Hichilema addresses the media following the close of presidential nominations and says his campaign for a second term has officially begun .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: June 4 June – Hichilema signs five bills into law covering education , pensions and local - authority superannuation .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 12 June – Hichilema launches the UPND 2026 – 2031 revised manifesto at the Mulungushi International Conference Centre in Lusaka , outlining the party 's seven " HH7 " targets for a second term .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 23 June – Hichilema begins his nationwide campaign for the 2026 general election , starting in Muchinga Province .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 28 June – Hichilema holds a campaign rally outside National Heroes Stadium in Lusaka , formally launching the UPND 's nationwide re-election campaign .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: July July was largely focused on campaigning for the 2026 general election , with Hichilema travelling across the country and holding rallies in several provinces .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: August August was dominated by the general election and the transition to Hichilema 's second term .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: August 6 – 7 – Hichilema visits six districts in North - Western Province during a two - day working visit .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: August 13 – Zambia holds its general election , with Hichilema seeking a second presidential term .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: August 18 – The Electoral Commission of Zambia declares Hichilema the winner of the presidential election .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: Hichilema delivers an acceptance speech and pledges to govern all Zambians .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 19 – 23 August – Hichilema begins preparations for his second - term inauguration following his re-election .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 24 August –

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: The seven - day deadline for filing a presidential election petition expires without a petition being recorded in the Constitutional Court Registry .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 26 – 31 August – Preparations continue for Hichilema 's second - term inauguration at National Heroes Stadium in Lusaka .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: September 1 September – Hichilema is sworn in for a second five - year term as President of Zambia at National Heroes Stadium in Lusaka .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: He and Vice - President Mutale Nalumango take their oaths of office before Chief Justice Mumba Malila .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: In his inaugural address , Hichilema launches the Grow Zambia agenda and pledges to serve all Zambians equally .

source.page_title: Timeline of the presidency of Hakainde Hichilema (2026)

text: 14 September – Hichilema appoints his first four members of his second cabinet , with Situmbeko Musokotwane reappointed as Minister of Finance and National Planning , Mulambo Haimbe reappointed as Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation , and Roma Chilengi and Gilbert Siame appointed as Minister of Health and Minister of Green Economy and Environment respectively .
